description: JavaScript gives a computer steps to follow. On a web page, it can count clicks, change words and check an answer. Think of a program as a recipe: the steps need to be clear and in the right order. Start by showing a message and adding numbers. Then learn to save values, make choices, repeat steps and work with the parts of a web page.
versionNote: Targets modern JavaScript (ECMAScript 2024/2025) as implemented by current browsers in 2026. No frameworks or build tools are required.
whatYouWillLearn: Show messages and do simple maths with code
Save values and make choices with them
Repeat steps and make reusable groups of steps
Make a page react to a click or a typed answer
learningObjectives: Show messages and do simple maths with code
